summary.title: Google re:Work
summary.one_liner: Google re:Work is a hub of people-management practices, research and examples organized into topics such as hiring, learning and development, analytics, org management and manager effectiveness.
takeaways: Google re:Work groups its management content into five topics: hiring and onboarding, data and analytics, learning and development, org management, and manager effectiveness.
The hiring section covers frameworks for job requirements, interviews and onboarding.
The analytics section covers using social and data science research to evaluate HR practices, programs and processes.
The site positions itself as a source of proven practices and research from Google and other institutions.
summary.summary: The Google re:Work landing page presents itself as a collection of people-management practices, real examples and research from Google and other institutions. It is organized into five topic areas: hiring and onboarding, data and analytics, learning and development, org management, and manager effectiveness. Each section gives a short description of its focus, such as interview frameworks, using data science to evaluate HR programs, and building high-performing teams. The page text is a brief overview; the individual articles it links to are not included here.
